title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: No behaviour changes. Last release narrowed the window that looks for a function body, and this one is about proving it lost nothing it should have kept.

highlights.title: Compared Finding By Finding
highlights.description: On a real project 14 reports leave and none arrives, and all 14 are methods declared in an interface. A count alone would not have settled it.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A signature can finish on a second line with `throws` in Java or `where` in Kotlin, and two methods of the real project do. A test now pins that the brace is still found there.

The two other branches that measure a declaration were re examined and need nothing: a property looks only at its own line, and a class header already walks its supertype list with a rule written for this hazard.
